description: Defines the HostResolverProc class interface for DNS resolution procedures, including chaining, fallback, and thread safety mechanisms within the net namespace.

classes.name: HostResolverProc
classes.description: Interface class for DNS host resolution procedures, supporting chaining, fallback, and thread safety.

methods.name: HostResolverProc
methods.description: Constructor initializing with previous resolver and fallback allowance.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Pure virtual method to resolve hostnames to address lists, with or without network handle.

methods.name: ResolveUsingPrevious
methods.description: Invokes the previous resolver in the chain.

methods.name: SetPreviousProc
methods.description: Sets the previous resolver in the chain.

methods.name: SetLastProc
methods.description: Appends a resolver to the end of the chain.

methods.name: GetLastProc
methods.description: Retrieves the last resolver in the chain.

methods.name: SetDefault
methods.description: Sets the default host resolver procedure used by HostResolverManager.

methods.name: GetDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the current default host resolver procedure.
